item.title: The Gospel According to Eastern Orthodoxy: A Biblical Evaluation
item.description: Samuel Farag evaluates Eastern Orthodoxy’s teachings in light of Scripture, comparing key doctrines to the biblical gospel and calling believers to discernment.

item.title: Job 13: Trusting God When Understanding Fails
item.description: In Job 13, Job trusts God even when understanding fails. This episode explores persevering faith, honest prayer, and hope rooted in God’s character.

item.title: Psalm 126: Sowing in Tears, Reaping in Joy
item.description: In this sermon on Psalm 126, Dave Jenkins teaches how believers live faithfully between remembered joy and present sorrow.

item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue explains why Christians must reject manifesting, vision boards, and spiritual shortcuts, and instead trust biblical prayer that submits to God’s sovereign will.

item.title: Job 14: Life Is Brief, but Resurrection Hope Endures
item.description: In Job 14, Job reflects on the brevity of life, the certainty of death, and the resurrection hope fulfilled in Jesus Christ.
